DuctStretch.description: A stretch of a duct between two positions along its path (from its first vertex), in nanometres.

from.description: Where the wire enters it, along its path.

to.description: Where the wire leaves it, along its path.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

RouteEnd.description: One end of a [`CommittedRoute`]: the pin it was laid from, as it was.

at.description: The pin's place in that surface's frame.

cp.description: The connection point, in a connection endpoint's form `[function, idx]`.

h.description: The pin's height above the surface.

surface.description: The surface the pin was on.

SurfacePt2.description: A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

WayStep.description: One step of a stored way: `{"duct": {carrier, from, to}}` or `{"door": surface}`.

oneOf.description: The crossing of a door's hinge onto that door.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

ends.description: The two ends, the wire's From end first.

run.description: The way's length as computed, before any reserve or loop is added or anything rounded.

space.description: The layout space whose cabinet the way runs in (delete policy cascade).

way.description: The steps of the way in order, from the first end; empty for a direct way.

wire.description: The physical wire, by its carrier connection (doc 08 §3.8; delete policy cascade).

title: committed_route
